channel.title: Through My Quiet Lens
channel.description: Essays, conversations and reflections on work, leadership, technology and everyday life.

item.title: The Editorial Page
item.description: How reading The Hindu with my grandfather taught me to look beyond what happened and ask what an argument was really trying to say.

item.title: Equality or Equity?
item.description: A ten-minute walk to school became a lesson in fairness, time and the wisdom that can come from the smallest voices.

item.title: The Value of Being Bored
item.description: Boredom once felt like empty time. Looking back, it may have been the space where curiosity, reading and reflection quietly took root.

item.title: Generative AI Optimises for the Statistical Average
item.description: Convenience removes the need to practise small habits. AI may be the next step in that quiet trade-off.

item.title: Beyond Networking: What 20+ Teams and 100+ People Taught Me
item.description: The most meaningful relationships rarely began with an introduction. They were built while solving problems and doing meaningful work together.

item.title: One Less Thing to Worry About
item.description: Customers may forget the presentation or the price. They remember whether your presence made a difficult moment easier.

item.title: Two Dogs After Forty Years
item.description: I spent most of my life without a dog. Percy and Pluto quietly changed what I notice about presence, patience and home.
